call_purpose: Leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you switched on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, and after a test form from another email you confirmed the email arrived and the autoresponder is now working.

covered.text: We explained that emails can sometimes go to spam, so it is a good idea to verify your sender domain, which you can do in Settings, in the email domain section.

customer_next_steps.text: Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of Settings.
customer_next_steps.timeline: tomorrow morning (the morning after the call)
